project_info.name: StudyMate
project_info.target_audience: College students turning raw lecture/class notes into summaries, flashcards, or quiz questions

tech_stack.frontend: React js (.js / .jsx files), Tailwind CSS, Lucide icons, Framer Motion, Shadcn UI primitives

design_archetype.name: Organic, Calm & Paper-Warm Focus
design_archetype.description: Distraction-free, paper-like warmth, serene study space aesthetics. Soft linen backgrounds, warm stone card borders, sage green accents, tactile typography.
design_archetype.emotional_tone: Focused, calming, reassuring, scholarly yet modern and approachable
anti_patterns: NO high-saturation futuristic glowing neon grids
NO heavy dark mode sci-fi tech gradients
NO cramped textareas or hidden input boxes
NO Inter/Space Grotesk for primary headings

font_family.headings: Lora, Newsreader, or Playfair Display, serif
font_family.body: Plus Jakarta Sans, DM Sans, or Work Sans, sans-serif

hierarchy.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-serif tracking-tight text-slate-900 leading-tight
hierarchy.caption: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous breathing space. The note input and generated study materials dominate the viewport.
layout_and_spacing.grid_structure: Dashboard uses asymmetric focus layout: Left dominant main workspace (col-span-12 lg:col-span-8), Right contextual sidebar / recent history (col-span-12 lg:col-span-4).

elements: Brand header with StudyMate logo and tag line ('Turn raw notes into exam-ready knowledge')
Email + Password fields with clean focus states and validation
Toggle between Login and Sign-up mode
Clear data-testid on submit buttons and input fields
Prominent Large Note Input Textarea (min-h-[260px]) with character/word counter and quick sample note loader button
Action Selector Tabs/Cards for 1. Summarise Notes, 2. Flashcards, 3. Quiz Questions
Primary Action Button: 'Generate Study Material' with glowing sage focus border & smooth spinner on active loading state
Recent Generation History drawer/panel showing last 5 creations with action badge and timestamp

result_view.summary_view: Structured executive summary, Key Concepts list with tag pills, Detailed Bulleted Breakdown, Actionable Takeaways, Copy & Export buttons
result_view.flashcards_view: Interactive 3D Flip Cards (Front: Question/Term, Back: Answer/Explanation) with Previous/Next controls, Flip button, Progress tracker (Card X of Y), Mastered / Needs Review flags
result_view.quiz_view: Interactive Multiple-Choice Questions, Choice selection with instantaneous tactile visual feedback, Check Answer mode, Explanations for correct/incorrect choices, Final Score Card with Retry option

elements: Filter by Action Type (All, Summaries, Flashcards, Quizzes)
Search input for filtering notes by keyword/topic
Card list with date created, title preview, action badge, quick delete button
Clicking item navigates to Previous-Generation Detail View
Full view of saved generation result
Source note viewer accordion / drawer ('View original raw notes')
Back to History / Back to Dashboard navigation button

motion_and_interactions.framer_motion_usage: Smooth entrance transitions, card flip rotation (rotateY 180deg), tab indicator animation
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Hover elevation (-translate-y-0.5), subtle border tint on focus, pulse loading state during AI text streaming
motion_and_interactions.flip_card_spec: 3D perspective container with perspective-1000, transition-transform duration-500 backface-hidden

image_urls.usage: Calm student library scene for onboarding/auth hero header
Library background image for login banner

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the light calm warm neutral design system described in this JSON.
Implement full mock AI generation engine powered by backend/frontend API using Claude Sonnet 4.6 context simulation.
Ensure all interactive items have data-testid attributes for testing.
Support key functionalities: Auth (Email/Password), Note Input, 3 AI Actions (Summarise, Flashcards, Quiz), Detailed Results, History view with search/filter/delete, Detail view.
Do not import TS or TSX files since codebase uses .js / .jsx.
Include responsive layout with smooth mobile navigation and flashcard gestures.
